en-US.longDescription: SteaScree is a simple cross-platform open-source utility app, which makes screenshots, taken without the use of Steam's in-game overlay, uploadable to the Steam Cloud. You just pick pics, a game and SteaScree will do the rest.
en-US.name: SteaScree

zh-CN.longDescription: SteaScree 是一款简单的跨平台开源实用程序，可以在不使用 Steam 游戏内覆盖的情况下进行截图并将其上传至 Steam 云。您只需挑选图片和游戏，其余的工作交给 SteaScree 完成。
zh-CN.name: SteaScree
